what: A large logo mark (image · SVG) is drawn with WebGL: when the mouse passes, it is pushed in the direction of movement, ripple rings and swirls spread, and chromatic aberration appears at the edges. The point following the mouse lags with 1 − .04^dt, and the energy accumulated by distance moved decays with a .75s half-life. Even when still, it ripples very slightly with fine noise (strength .35 · radius .85 · ripple .2)

options.radius: Radius the mouse reaches (share of panel height), default .85
options.pad: Mark padding (so blurred edges aren’t clipped), default .25
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Brand mark — Me Inline
options.--fx-ripple-blend: Canvas blend (original is an overlay on the photo), default normal

note: On touch devices (hover false) it does not follow the hand and only a small ripple remains. With reduced motion the mark is left as is

from.where: index.js Hero large logo mark (translucent dark brown .6 · overlay)
